title: USART_CR1_M_Msk  define missing
body:
Hello,

all other STM32 device headers define USART_CR1_M_Msk . for STM32H7RS it is missing. Please add.

comments.author: KRASTM
comments.body:
Hello @UweBonnes,

The issue you reported has been fixed in the frame of version v1.1.0 of the STM32CubeH7RS CMSIS published recently on GitHub. Thank you again for having reported.

With regards.
